title: A readout, up close
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /reports · interior head (kit §12.3) cast at 104, stacked · sheet plate (kit §12.4)
summary: The h1 writes in over a plain lede and one quiet action, and the plate under it is page 1 of the one readout this page shows, drawn at the same scale as the pages that follow (half a spread's width): running head with “Specimen”, the invented company named once, the constraint sentence as the page's one large line; the plate takes its height from the page and its edge crops the page in blank paper under the second paragraph, never through a line.
story: Opening beat. The visitor came for proof; the first thing under the headline is the deliverable itself, page one, with its one sentence at reading size. The lede adds what the h1 doesn't (the client keeps it; it is read together on the 60-minute call). The one action jumps to the case-study request, the founder's round-8 ask.

reference.site: GoNimbly solutions pages (the founder's recordings: media plate directly under the head, rising and widening on arrival) · printed consulting readouts (cover page: running head, one summary sentence)
reference.borrowed: GoNimbly's order (h1 → short lede → one quiet action → the picture at full measure); a printed report's first page.
reference.kelwin: The picture is Kelwin's own document, not footage: a paper page lying on the graphite plate with the kit's four registration marks (the only plate kind that carries them), the same page size as the spreads below, so the readout reads as one document at one scale. No facts box, no breadcrumb, no band, no chips.

motion: entrance (kit §13, stitched page): the turn lifts; the h1 writes itself in with the line-locked pen; the rule, lede and action follow the last letter; then the plate rises as a narrower rectangle and widens to the measure.
interaction: the action is an in-page jump (.ac-go--down) to the case-study request.
reduced motion: final state, no turn, no write-in.
